The model

A foundation model that knows one place completely.

Global Earth-observation models are trained to be adequate everywhere, and are therefore expert nowhere. We are building the opposite.

Scoped and trained on Mleiha alone.

Thirty-seven wheat fields in the Sharjah desert, three seasons of satellite passes, nothing else. Trained and running on Sharjah's own compute — the model, the data and the outputs stay inside the emirate. We have found no published precedent for adapting an Earth-observation foundation model to an area this small.

Sovereign capability

Every country now needs its own eyes, and its own models.

Ten years ago a nation could buy its satellite imagery and its analysis from somewhere else and call that a space programme. That is no longer enough. The imagery is becoming commodity; the model that reads it is becoming sovereignty.

We build it where it is used.The model is trained on the country's own ground, on compute inside its own borders, by people who will still be there next season. The weights stay. The data stays. The capability stays.

And we hand over the keys.Our work is not a subscription to a black box somewhere else. It is a model your institutions own, your agronomists correct, and your auditors can open.

If you are taking your country into space, and into agentic AI on the ground — that is the road we are already on. Come and walk it with us.

Where we work

Four countries. One method.

Bangladesh

Flood extent and persistence read from radar for crop insurance on the Jamuna floodplain — through cloud, and at night.

Uganda

National agriculture monitoring, scoped with the ministry across districts and protected areas.

Oman

Marine incident reconstruction off Al Hallaniyat — what was on the water, when, and what the radar saw.

How we got here

Built slowly, in the open.

2023

Rome

Invited to the Hand-in-Hand Initiative Investment Forum in Rome, where the problem we had been circling for years was finally stated at global scale: finance cannot reach land it cannot measure.

2024–25

Ministries, not slide decks

Working sessions with agriculture ministries across Africa, Central Asia and the Gulf, with pilots scoped on live platforms rather than proposals.

2026

Registered in Sharjah

Alma Earth registered under the SPARK AI Hub at Sharjah Research Technology and Innovation Park, and MleihaEarth — our first sovereign Earth-observation model — went into training on Sharjah compute.

If you govern land, finance it, or insure it — we should talk.

Tell us the decision you need to make, and we will tell you honestly whether we can measure it yet. When we cannot, we will say so.
